iteration_policy: Corrections produce a new version/attempt graph and invalidate affected evidence. Do not add backward edges or silently weaken the fixed DAG.
layers: L0 formalization foundations and worked model slice
L3 complete combined theory and owner disposition
objective: All current and future definitions receive source-faithful formal interpretations, declared semantic non-collapse checks, exact evidence and one combined satisfiable inhabited theory at stated strengths.

predecessor.preservation: Exact predecessor retained; this successor owns the new ordering.

priority_request: Definition kinds, logical and other formalization foundations before tooling and all-definition rollout.
scheduling_policy: M01-M09 gate all prior implementation. Prefer F01-T after its actual prerequisites; no invented semantic dependency order or early full-definition proof claim.
semantic_dependency_policy: Explicit uses_definition declarations; SCCs jointly analyzed; prohibited normative value cycles remain separate obligations. Unknown semantic edges never count as complete.
status: foundations-first candidate plan; foundation preview drafted; execution and review not claimed
task_graph_meaning: Edges are procedural prerequisites, not Lab Relation Kinds or inferred semantic dependencies.

tasks.acceptance: Primitive, explicit, axiomatic, inductive and operational cases are distinct; Axiom artifact is not an axiom assertion; inherited labels do not force equivalence.
tasks.implementation_rules: Separate artifact kind, definitional form, logical statement role, signature shape and logic features. Classify clauses, not just whole artifacts; allow mixed forms and unresolved classifications. Read the eight F01 sources first.
tasks.title: Definition forms and classification axes

tasks.acceptance: Invariant to be checked cannot be inserted as an assumption to prove itself; hypothesis is not silently adopted as a premise; an accepted premise is not established truth.
tasks.implementation_rules: Specify definitions, selected axioms, premises, hypotheses, obligations, derived claims and observations. Separate vocabulary/theory declarations from properties to establish. Record selection, scope, dependence and source precedence for each premise.
tasks.title: Logical roles and assumption discipline

tasks.acceptance: Ill-typed application and unbound symbol diagnosed; same labels retain distinct scope identities; nominal disjoint types cannot manufacture semantic distinction.
tasks.implementation_rules: Specify sorts, constants, total/partial functions, predicates, typed relations, arity and scope-qualified identifiers; distinguish semantic primitives from programming types; require explicit common-carrier alignment.
tasks.title: Signatures, carriers and identity

tasks.acceptance: No guessed meaning for iff, implication, quantification or non-entailment notation; recursive iff is not a least fixed point; unsupported operators remain unresolved.
tasks.implementation_rules: Specify grammar, binding and typing rules for a candidate classical many-sorted first-order static core; declare finite evaluation as a bounded profile. Specify entry criteria for inductive/recursive, temporal, deontic and empirical/probabilistic extensions without claiming their implementation.
tasks.title: Logical language and fragment boundaries

tasks.acceptance: Missing evidence is not falsehood; empty required population is not a useful distinction proof; operational unknown is not silently made a third truth value; plain-language authority strings are not authentication.
tasks.implementation_rules: Define structures, environments and satisfaction independently from executable checking. Declare domain/cardinality policies, partial values, unknown versus absent versus false, open/closed-world behavior and state/trace interpretations.
tasks.title: Denotation, truth and information state

tasks.acceptance: Keep allowed couplings and subtype overlap; no pairwise consistency aggregation; no label-derived edges; legitimate recursion and prohibited constraining cycles are separately handled.
tasks.implementation_rules: Specify definition expansion, selected assumptions and constraints, external dependencies, shared carriers and SCC semantics. Specify aliases, subtype inclusion/properness, overlap, disjointness and forbidden inferences; separate allowed-state theory from invariant-preservation proof domain.
tasks.title: Theory composition and semantic relationships

tasks.acceptance: Witness non-entailment differs from universal separation; bounded absence differs from unbounded proof; contradictory assumptions cannot count as non-vacuity; observations do not prove universal laws.
tasks.implementation_rules: Specify source fidelity, well-formedness, closure, model existence, joint inhabitation, relation obligations, transition preservation and separately selected conservativity. Give each exact statement, prerequisites, minimum evidence strength and failure outcomes.
tasks.title: Obligation types and evidence strengths

tasks.acceptance: Expose Hypothesis target meaning versus inherited Premise expression; do not fix canonical sources; show theorem versus premise separation and a non-vacuous invariant-preservation case; do not claim full translation from fragments.
tasks.implementation_rules: Apply the model first to Definition, Semantic Primitive, Schema, Axiom, Premise, Hypothesis, Invariant and Governed Model. Bind exact source selectors; add small alias/subtype/induction/transition controls as explicitly synthetic examples. Record every omission and unresolved clause precedence.
tasks.title: Worked foundation examples and ambiguity ledger

tasks.acceptance: Actual review of exact bytes or pending/rejected outcome; no generated approval; agreed core and explicit fragment limits before A01; this review grants no source revision or semantic admission.
tasks.implementation_rules: Assemble exact taxonomy, logical language, semantics, relationships, obligations, examples and unresolved decisions. Obtain actual attributable model-design disposition; carry required unresolved issues as blockers before lowering to schemas and evaluators.
tasks.title: Foundation model review and implementation contract

tasks.acceptance: Delete each required key; supply extra fields, duplicate identities and wrong types; all return typed unresolved/malformed records, never a raw traceback or silent pass.
tasks.implementation_rules: Specify closed interpretation, source, relation, assumption, population and result schemas; reject duplicate JSON keys and unknown fields; route malformed inputs to typed outcomes before semantic evaluation.
tasks.title: Strict candidate input contracts

tasks.acceptance: All 183 sources verified; stale hash, replaced lookup, missing file, duplicate version and capture race fail; preserve historical records and all input bytes.
tasks.implementation_rules: Resolve current_lookup to unique exact entries; read and hash bytes once inside an allowed root; bind admission decision references; verify source ID/version; recheck the registry before publication.
tasks.title: Exact source resolver and immutable capture

tasks.acceptance: Exactly 183 current rows and 189 admitted version entries; zero silent omissions; no textual mention counted as proof; source drift gets an explicit status.
tasks.implementation_rules: Inventory every selected definition and historical predecessor; distinguish prose, exact bindings and replayed proofs; inspect indirect source mappings as explicit leads; emit one total current queue.
tasks.title: Complete source and formalization assessment

tasks.acceptance: Owner sees realistic instance and counterexample; no inherited scaffold paragraph becomes an axiom by default; missing clauses/dependencies cannot count as complete.
tasks.implementation_rules: Define typed signatures and canonical statements; map every normative clause, boundary and example to encoded, premise, explanatory, deferred or unresolved; declare explicit semantic dependencies and source precedence.
tasks.title: Interpretation and clause-correspondence contract

tasks.acceptance: Positive alias, proper subtype and explicit coupling controls pass; false alias, collapsed distinction, empty required population and unaligned carriers remain failed/unresolved.
tasks.implementation_rules: Specify aliases, subtype inclusion/properness, overlap, disjointness and named forbidden inferences; distinguish non-entailment from all-model distinction; assign required or explicitly exempt population obligations per carrier.
tasks.title: Relation semantics and population policy

tasks.acceptance: Omitted, substituted or weakened required obligation is rejected; all negative controls are checked against the independently required statement set.
tasks.implementation_rules: Derive requirements from reviewed relation policy, signature and change class; generate a manifest with exact statements, strength and prerequisites; input submitters cannot shrink the denominator.
tasks.title: Required obligation denominator

tasks.acceptance: Source-backed interpretation alternatives and realistic examples; ungranted claim and unknown origin expressible; move/record mismatch and unrecorded grant changes rejected.
tasks.implementation_rules: Separate owner grants, claims and rights/responsibilities; define empty/unknown/incomplete provenance; bind each move to exact subject before/after states and active grants; document the candidate admission-use coupling.
tasks.title: Pilot semantic successor specification

tasks.acceptance: Same positive distinction and authorized overlap; additionally claim-without-grant, unrelated subject move and incomplete claim variants are exercised.
tasks.implementation_rules: Author v2 candidate in a new absent directory; implement independent record and transition predicates against sealed signatures; retain v1 intact; keep counterexample queries out of the theory.
tasks.title: Isolated successor pilot

tasks.acceptance: Collapse, contradiction, vacuity, missing dependency, missing translation, malformed input, stale source, unsupported profile and real cancellation/timeout receive their exact outcomes.
tasks.implementation_rules: Run actual satisfiability, inhabitation and distinction queries; independently replay models and all finite configurations; record trust assumptions and exact budgets.
tasks.title: Successor pilot replay and controls

tasks.acceptance: Actual attributable owner fidelity review for exact bytes, or explicit pending state; no simulated approval and no canonical source mutation.
tasks.implementation_rules: Present exact candidate clauses, omissions, examples, witnesses and assumptions to semantic owner; record fidelity decisions separately from semantic admission; rejected clauses route to a new candidate iteration.
tasks.title: Pilot correspondence review

tasks.acceptance: Malformed and ill-sorted statements rejected; equal labels do not merge identities; distinct nominal types do not prove non-collapse; serialize deterministically.
tasks.implementation_rules: Define closed sorts, variables, predicates, relation applications, equality, Boolean connectives and supported quantifiers; namespace by exact definition/scope; explicit shared-carrier alignment; unsupported constructs stay visible.
tasks.title: Typed canonical theory IR

tasks.acceptance: Hand-derived models, empty domains, alias/subtype/overlap controls and parser correspondence checked; no StaticConforms := checker=true as semantic specification.
tasks.implementation_rules: Define model satisfaction independently from Boolean acceptance; evaluate each supported AST node under an explicit environment and domain; separate T from queried obligations and populations.
tasks.title: Independent denotation and evaluator

tasks.acceptance: Two-node mutual definition SCC accepted for joint analysis; a prohibited constraining cycle separately rejected; unbound edge remains unresolved; reverse closure includes all affected nodes.
tasks.implementation_rules: Consume only author-declared uses_definition edges; resolve all transitive refs; compute strongly connected components; retain edge basis; condense to an execution order without erasing normative cycle restrictions.
tasks.title: Dependency graph and SCC compiler

tasks.acceptance: No provider selected by labels alone; missing runtime, unsupported logic and weaker-than-required evidence block that obligation; no install is performed by this planning task.
tasks.implementation_rules: Assess logic requirements before availability; inventory exact installed builds; choose finite/SMT/proof routes and minimum strengths by obligation; isolate any later installs; seal budgets and candidate profile policy.
tasks.title: Provider capability and evidence thresholds

tasks.acceptance: Two independently derived theories replay; bounded no-witness never claims unbounded separation/consistency; resource exhaustion is unknown; memory bounded by profile.
tasks.implementation_rules: Enumerate the exact finite interpretation rather than the two fixed pilot IDs; stream a first witness and counters; record domain and exhaustion completeness; enforce cancellation and resource limits.
tasks.title: Generic finite model provider

tasks.acceptance: Witness replay for sat; exact solver-result ceiling for unsat; unsupported quantifiers and timeout unresolved; nominal sort partition cannot supply a distinction.
tasks.condition: Selected evidence-strength policy requires this provider; otherwise exact not-applicable receipt required.
tasks.implementation_rules: If sealed profiles require SMT, lower the supported IR fragment with explicit sort/cardinality rules and preservation map; bind native formula/build/flags; normalize sat, unsat and unknown; otherwise record exact non-applicability.
tasks.title: Selected SMT provider projection

tasks.acceptance: Generic theorem over arbitrary supported finite inputs, not one fixture; exact statement/dependencies/toolchain checked; model existence and required inhabitation remain separate obligations.
tasks.condition: Selected evidence-strength policy requires this provider; otherwise exact not-applicable receipt required.
tasks.implementation_rules: When mechanized claims are required, select pinned proof runtime; prove evaluator-to-independent-denotation correctness and supported obligation-generation coverage; audit axioms and reject assumed conclusion/sorry; otherwise retain trusted-checker ceiling explicitly.
tasks.title: Mechanized correctness and universal route

tasks.acceptance: Atomic transaction/replay and recursive lineage obligations retain their actual semantics; bounded trace absence is not universal liveness; projections cannot be independently SAT-joined as one model without compatibility proof.
tasks.condition: Selected evidence-strength policy requires this provider; otherwise exact not-applicable receipt required.
tasks.implementation_rules: If actual clause coverage requires transition or fixed-point semantics outside existing profiles, select one bounded temporal/recursive adapter or a mechanized encoding; define preservation to canonical IR and explicit bounds; otherwise bind non-applicability. Never choose an engine from a lifecycle/research label.
tasks.title: Selected temporal or recursive profile extension

tasks.acceptance: Unknown, unsupported, stale and missing evidence cannot aggregate to ready; actual result data and all required statements are present; schema-only validation never labeled proof.
tasks.implementation_rules: Bind sources, interpretation, dependencies, required statements, profile, tool versions, assumptions, native inputs/results and review statuses; keep execution/currentness/fidelity/verdict/strength/readiness separate.
tasks.title: Exact evidence bundle contract

tasks.acceptance: Interrupted and colliding publication preserves inputs and existing output; modified evidence/version does not reuse an old bundle identity; no frozen registry/schema edits.
tasks.implementation_rules: Capture a closed manifest; write a private absent staging directory; publish create-only without overwriting competing paths; verify final source currentness; preserve attempts and old evidence.
tasks.title: Immutable candidate bundle publisher

tasks.acceptance: Omit a statement, change a witness, substitute a dependency or provider build; all rejected; historical proof remains historical rather than deleted.
tasks.implementation_rules: Resolve the required set independently from submitted result list; rehash all inputs and current bindings; check model witnesses against independent denotation; distinguish checker trust from mechanized proof; reject incomplete submissions.
tasks.title: Independent evidence verifier

tasks.acceptance: All declared controls fail/pass for named causes; no malformed input escape; never alter canonical inputs to make a control pass.
tasks.implementation_rules: Build exact-cause fixtures across schemas, semantics, alias/subtype policy, witness verification, scope, source races and budgets; keep control mutations in copied candidate inputs.
tasks.title: Adversarial control suite

tasks.acceptance: Changed leaf invalidates all dependants; deleted/new definition changes the global denominator; unchanged cache entry rehashed, not trusted as authority.
tasks.implementation_rules: Compare source and semantic dependency fingerprints; traverse reverse edges including SCCs; invalidate source/interpretation/assumption/coupling/profile/tool/statement changes; separate semantic and representation deltas.
tasks.title: Transitive invalidation

tasks.acceptance: Mislabelled change cannot reduce checks; source-only relabel does not create identity equivalence; obsolete requirements cannot silently disappear.
tasks.implementation_rules: Compute exact baseline/proposal diff; classify source, representation, meaning, premise and coupling changes; regenerate affected requirements; preservation/conservativity claims are explicit extra obligations.
tasks.title: Addition and revision obligation generation

tasks.acceptance: Three constraints pairwise satisfiable but jointly contradictory fail; local distinction successes never substitute for full satisfiability and inhabitation.
tasks.implementation_rules: Compile all included interpretations, axioms and couplings together; check T and T plus required populations before distinctions; recheck affected neighbours; full selected theory required despite local cache reuse.
tasks.title: Whole selected-snapshot regression

tasks.acceptance: An unreviewed or missing translation visibly prevents semantic readiness; output inventory matches manifest; commands do not touch admissions or live registry.
tasks.implementation_rules: Expose capture/check/verify/diff/report commands with JSON and human views; declared absent outputs only; report exact whole-definition and projection coverage, remaining premises, failures and next unit.
tasks.title: Read-only candidate CLI and coverage report

tasks.acceptance: Currentness and failure routes visible end to end; no live admission integration; effects require future exact owner decisions.
tasks.implementation_rules: Run one addition, one semantic revision and one representation revision through copied baseline inputs; show revised meanings and realistic examples; preserve source owners and exact review distinctions.
tasks.title: Addition/revision workflow rehearsal

tasks.acceptance: First repeatable selected-scope workflow credible; no all-definition coverage claim; no skipped required obligation or owner review.
tasks.implementation_rules: Join the successor-pilot correspondence, required controls, reproducible evidence and selected-snapshot regression receipts; review layer exit evidence.
tasks.title: L1 candidate workflow exit

tasks.acceptance: All 183 identities accounted; each dependency resolves or is explicit unresolved; no edge inferred from a term/primary_consumer_ref; cycles analyzed jointly.
tasks.implementation_rules: After all source-bound drafts, review every declared uses_definition edge and unresolved reference; seal SCCs, shared signatures, foundational premises and provisional family interfaces; regenerate SCC execution slices before running an incomplete closure.
tasks.title: Full semantic dependency declaration closure

tasks.acceptance: All pair decisions covered without blind inequalities; Lab/Craft homonyms analyzed; subtype overlap and aliases retained; unresolved alignment prevents comparison readiness.
tasks.implementation_rules: Consider all 16,653 unordered current-identity pairs for relevance; record comparable relation, directional strength or exact scoped non-comparability reason; seal shared carrier maps, explicit couplings and neighbour obligations.
tasks.title: Neighbour, alias and carrier-alignment matrix

tasks.acceptance: 183 current identities each have complete required records or explicit unresolved disposition; administrative accounting does not imply 183 proved meanings.
tasks.implementation_rules: Join every family closure; independently compare source denominator, clause mappings, required obligations, evidence, reviews and residual assumptions; disposition every unsupported item without marking it satisfied.
tasks.title: All-current translation and evidence accounting

tasks.acceptance: No omitted axiom/predicate/constraint/bridge; no nominal disjointness inserted to pass; one exact theory digest and complete statement denominator.
tasks.implementation_rules: Merge exact symbols and dependencies using reviewed carrier alignments; expand definitions or include explicit axioms; all cross-family couplings included; preserve scope distinctions and normalized source traceability.
tasks.title: One combined canonical theory

tasks.acceptance: A full model plus inhabitants for all declared required carriers, or exact unsat/unknown/unsupported outcome; pairwise or partial-profile passes insufficient.
tasks.implementation_rules: Run one supported full-theory model check with every required population in the same model; audit assumptions; independently verify witness; if any construct is unsupported, declare full result unresolved.
tasks.title: Joint satisfiability and required inhabitation

tasks.acceptance: Known triple contradiction and empty-population controls pinpoint sources; exact incompatibility explanation; unsat core not claimed minimal without checking.
tasks.implementation_rules: Map cores/counterexamples to source clauses and assumptions; use bounded minimization only as diagnostic; create semantic patch proposals and new iterations rather than weaken constraints silently.
tasks.title: Contradiction and vacuity diagnosis

tasks.acceptance: Exact statements and generic proof evidence for required supported claims; absent/timeout/unsupported proofs remain visible and non-pass.
tasks.implementation_rules: Discharge only explicitly demanded universal distinction/preservation/checker propositions; audit actual kernel dependencies and assumptions; a theorem under assumptions does not establish those assumptions satisfiable.
tasks.title: Required universal obligations and assumption audit

tasks.acceptance: Cross-family collapse/contradiction rejected; legitimate alias and subtype extension retained; selected-data compatibility not called model conservativity.
tasks.implementation_rules: Apply copied addition/revision/coupling/alias diffs across families; re-evaluate exact full theory and all required populations; compare old and new meanings, requirements and currentness.
tasks.title: Full-snapshot change regression

tasks.acceptance: Complete evidence inventory reproduced/verified at declared strength; no stale source or missing dependency; replay preserves historical results and unrelated work.
tasks.implementation_rules: On a clean candidate output tree, resolve exact source inputs, replay the complete statement set and verify witnesses/proofs without accepting provider summaries; recheck all current source bindings before closeout.
tasks.title: Clean independent replay

tasks.acceptance: No umbrella all-definition consistency statement unless whole included semantics actually checked; dispositions distinguish incomplete assurance from administrative closeout.
tasks.implementation_rules: Produce separate source/translation/fidelity/evidence/strength/currentness dimensions for every definition and full snapshot; assign owner routes to all unresolved outcomes and epistemic assumptions.
tasks.title: Final coverage and limitation ledger

tasks.acceptance: Concrete inspectable package, exact digests and scope; semantic revision proposals separate from fidelity reviews; no implicit authority effect.
tasks.implementation_rules: Assemble revised interpretations and realistic examples for all exact subjects; show contrasts, sources, evidence ceilings, unresolved outcomes and proposed effects; stage any selected application artifacts before the owner decision.
tasks.title: Exact owner review package

tasks.acceptance: Attributable exact dispositions, or explicit pending state; owner silence is not approval; unchecked concepts not called proved.
tasks.implementation_rules: Record actual owner choices over exact interpretations and any separately requested semantic-source changes; partial or rejected results remain visible; no actual admission action in the planning scope.
tasks.title: Owner semantic disposition

tasks.acceptance: No effect beyond selected decisions; no implementation coupling into another active project by default; deferred/no-admission branch valid and recorded.
tasks.condition: Later owner explicitly selects exact admission effects; otherwise no-effect disposition.
tasks.implementation_rules: If the owner explicitly selects admission effects, recheck currentness and deliver the exact staged candidate to the admitted workflow owner; live application requires its own explicit authorized scope and effects.
tasks.title: Selected admission-owner handoff

tasks.acceptance: Completion wording obeys evidence limits; no incomplete translation/theory called complete; local candidate status synchronization only unless later exact admission authorized.
tasks.implementation_rules: Write project-owned delivery status reflecting actual achieved coverage, pending obligations and any separate effect receipts; preserve original pilot/planning snapshots and point to the next actual unit.
tasks.title: Project closeout and continuation
